Tool reference

Every tool an agent can call on a default install: 474 tools in 44 domains. This page is generated from the MCP server source, so it matches the code it ships with.

The server starts with 7 tools. An agent finds the rest with hayba_search_tools and calls them with hayba_invoke. How Code Mode works.

Startup and discovery 8

get_tool_signature

Registered at startup.

Return the JSON schema (params, return shape, cost) for a specific HaybaOS command. Call list_tool_categories first to find command names.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
command string Required Exact command name, e.g. "actor_spawn"

hayba_check_ue_status

Registered at startup.

Check whether the Unreal editor bridge is reachable and report its current identity and status.

No parameters.

hayba_introspect

Introspect UE reflection: editor-property names+types of a class/struct, member values of an enum, or input/output pin labels of a PCG node (by graph+node) or settings class. Kills trial-and-error API discovery.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
target string Optional What to introspect. For mode="class"/"enum": a Python-visible name (e.g. "Rotator", "StaticMeshComponent", "ECollisionEnabled") or a full class path. For mode="pcg_node": ignored unless settings_class is omitted.
mode "class" | "enum" | "pcg_node" | "auto" Optional class = editor properties; enum = member names+values; pcg_node = pin labels of a node; auto = guess from target. Default: "auto".
pcg_graph string Optional PCG graph asset path (mode="pcg_node"). Use with node_id.
node_id string Optional Node title/name within the PCG graph (mode="pcg_node").
settings_class string Optional PCG settings class name (e.g. "PCGSurfaceSamplerSettings") — introspect pins WITHOUT an existing graph node.

hayba_invoke

Registered at startup.

CALL ANY TOOL BY NAME, whether or not its pack is loaded — the whole catalogue is reachable through here. Pair with hayba_search_tools when you do not know the name. USE_WHEN: any call into an unloaded domain, which is most of them. NOT_WHEN: you are making many calls into one domain — hayba_pack_load gives you native schemas.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
name string Required
args object (map) Optional Default: {}.
via "ts" | "ue_legacy" Optional Dispatch route. "ts" (default) looks the tool up in the TS captured map. "ue_legacy" calls executeCommand(name, args) directly against the UE plugin — only commands marked agent_callable:true in legacy-commands/sidecar.json are accepted. Default: "ts".
idempotency_key string Optional Retry identity for a mutation. This is envelope metadata, never forwarded as a tool parameter. Requires an authenticated MCP principal; receipts are process-local and expire.

hayba_pack_list

Registered at startup.

List the tool packs — domain packs group one subsystem, workflow packs bundle a task across subsystems. Shows tool counts and which are loaded. USE_WHEN: you want the map of what exists. NOT_WHEN: you want a specific capability — hayba_search_tools is faster than reading the map.

No parameters.

hayba_pack_load

Registered at startup.

Register a pack natively so its tools appear in your tool list with full schemas. This is an OPTIMISATION for repeated use, not a prerequisite: hayba_invoke already calls any tool without it. USE_WHEN: you are about to make several calls into one domain. NOT_WHEN: one-off call — just invoke it.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
name string Required

hayba_search_tools

Registered at startup.

FIND A TOOL BY DESCRIBING WHAT YOU WANT, in plain language ("make a menu widget", "why is my landscape flat"). Searches the FULL catalogue, including the tools that are not registered yet — most of them are not, by design. Returns tool names you can pass straight to hayba_invoke without loading anything. USE_WHEN: you do not already know the exact tool name. NOT_WHEN: you know the name — just hayba_invoke it.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
query string Required
k integer Optional
filterPack string Optional

list_tool_categories

Registered at startup.

List all HaybaOS command domains and their commands. Call this first to discover what is available before requesting a specific schema.

No parameters.

Actors 22

actor_batch_spawn

Spawn many actors in ONE call from an array of {class_path, location?, rotation?, scale?, label?}. Prefer this over repeated actor_spawn: one round trip and one transaction instead of N.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actors any[] Required array of {class_path, location?, rotation?, scale?, label?}

actor_batch_transform

Transform many actors in one call: each entry sets absolute location/rotation/scale (omitted fields unchanged). Returns per-actor before/after read-back. Undo granularity follows the editor default (one python exec).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
transforms object[] Required Per-actor transform edits; each omitted field is left unchanged

actor_call_function

Call a BlueprintCallable UFunction on an actor by name, with arguments. The escape hatch for behaviour no dedicated tool exposes — powerful and unvalidated, so it is gated by Plan Mode.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required
function_name string Required
args object (map) Optional

actor_delete

Destroy an actor in the active level.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required

actor_duplicate

Copy an existing actor, optionally placing the copy at a new transform. Keeps the source's properties, so it is the cheap way to repeat a configured actor rather than spawning and re-setting everything.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required
location any[] Optional
rotation any[] Optional
scale any[] Optional
label string Optional

actor_find

Query level actors by label substring, exact class, tag, and/or a spatial radius around a point. Paginated. Returns {actors[], total, has_more}.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
label_contains string Optional Case-insensitive substring match on the actor label
class_name string Optional Exact class name filter, e.g. "StaticMeshActor"
tag string Optional Exact actor tag filter
near number[] Optional [x,y,z] centre for a spatial radius filter
radius_cm number Optional Radius in cm around `near` (requires `near`)
limit integer Optional Max actors returned (pagination) Default: 100.
offset integer Optional Pagination offset Default: 0.

actor_focus

Frame the editor viewport camera on an actor (selects it and aligns the active viewport). For the vision loop before a screenshot.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required Actor label or full path to frame in the viewport

actor_get_components

List an actor's components with their class and name. Use this before object_set_property or actor_call_function, which both need the component name. include_internal also returns engine-created components you normally do not touch.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required
include_internal boolean Optional

actor_get_properties

Reflect every property on an actor with its current value. The discovery step before actor_set_properties — property names must match the UPROPERTY exactly, and this is how you learn them instead of guessing.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required

actor_get_selection

Read the current editor actor selection.

No parameters.

actor_inspect

Full read-back of a level actor: class, transform, bounds, components, material slots, tags, outliner folder, attach parent. The inspection half of the inspect-then-edit loop.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required Actor label (outliner name) or full path

actor_list

List what is in the scene: every actor in the active level with its label, class and transform. Start here when you need to know what already exists before changing anything.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
class_filter string Optional Exact class name filter
tag string Optional Tag filter

actor_set_folder

Move actors into a world-outliner folder (organisation). Empty folder string moves to the root. Returns per-actor read-back of the applied folder.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_ids string[] Required Actor labels or full paths to move
folder string Required World-outliner folder path, e.g. "Buildings/District01". Empty string moves to the root.

actor_set_properties

Set actor properties from a name to value map. Names must match the UPROPERTY exactly; a name the actor does not have is reported back rather than silently dropped, so read the response instead of assuming it applied.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required
properties object (map) Required name to value map; structs/enums/vectors supported

actor_set_selection

Replace the editor actor selection with the given actors (by label or path). Returns the resolved selection + any unresolved ids.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_ids string[] Required Actor labels or full paths to select (replaces the current selection)

actor_set_visibility

Show or hide an actor in the level. This is editor/runtime visibility only — the actor still exists, still ticks and still collides.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required
visible boolean Required

actor_snap_to_socket

Attach an actor to a named socket on another actor, so it follows that socket's transform. The usual way to put a prop in a hand, a light on a fixture, or a decal on a mount point.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required
target_actor_id string Required
socket_name string Required

actor_spawn

Place a new actor in the active level by class — a light, a volume, a blueprint actor, or any registered UClass. To place a StaticMesh or other content asset by its path instead, use actor_spawn_from_asset.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
class_path string Required UE class path, e.g. "/Script/Engine.StaticMeshActor"
location [number, number, number] Optional
rotation [number, number, number] Optional
scale [number, number, number] Optional
label string Optional

actor_spawn_from_asset

Spawn an actor from a content asset path (StaticMesh or Blueprint) without knowing the actor class. Optional snap_to_floor line-traces down onto geometry. Returns actor_id + final transform read-back. NON-IDEMPOTENT.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
asset_path string Required Content path of a StaticMesh or Blueprint asset, e.g. "/Game/Meshes/SM_Rock"
location number[] Optional [x,y,z] spawn location (default [0,0,0])
rotation number[] Optional [roll,pitch,yaw] spawn rotation (default [0,0,0])
label string Optional Optional actor label
snap_to_floor boolean Optional Line-trace straight down from the spawn point and seat the actor on the first hit Default: false.

actor_tag

Add or remove gameplay tags on an actor in one call. Tagging marks an actor's role so PCG filters and gameplay code can select it by tag rather than by name.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required
add any[] Optional
remove any[] Optional

actor_transform

Reposition, rotate, or scale an existing actor.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required
location [number, number, number] Optional
rotation [number, number, number] Optional
scale [number, number, number] Optional

placement_validate

Asks whether an actor of this class would collide with anything if spawned at this transform, WITHOUT spawning it. Use it before actor_spawn when placing into a populated scene — cheaper than spawning, checking, and deleting. It answers about overlap only: it does not tell you whether the spot makes sense, is on navmesh, or is inside geometry.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
class_path string Required Class you intend to spawn, e.g. /Script/Engine.StaticMeshActor
location any[] Optional [x,y,z] of the intended placement. A short array is an error, not a silent zero — a 2-element location once made this report a clean spot at the origin.
rotation any[] Optional [pitch,yaw,roll]
scale any[] Optional [x,y,z]

Agent memory 7

memory_delete

Delete memory blocks: a single block by id, every block from one agentRole, or (with confirm_all) the entire store. Exactly one of id / agentRole / confirm_all is required.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
id string Optional Delete exactly this block
agentRole string Optional Delete every block written by this role
confirm_all boolean Optional Set true to delete the entire store — required, not inferred

memory_export

Dump memory blocks (optionally filtered by scope/agentRole) to a portable JSON file for backup or transfer to another store via memory_import.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required File path to write the export JSON to
scope "private" | "shared" Optional
agentRole string Optional

memory_import

Load a memory_export JSON file back into the store. Reports exactly what happened per row: inserted, skipped (malformed), or conflicted (id already existed — left alone under "skip", overwritten under "replace").

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required File path previously written by memory_export
on_conflict "skip" | "replace" Optional How to handle an id that already exists (default "skip")

memory_list

List recent memory blocks for a role/scope, most-recent-first, with no keyword filter. Use to browse what has been written, not to search for something specific.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
scope "private" | "shared" Optional
agentRole string Optional
limit integer Optional Max blocks to return (default 50)

memory_prune

Force retention to run now with an explicit (or default-configured) age/count bound. memory_write already does this automatically after every insert — use this only to prune on demand with a tighter one-off bound.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
max_count integer Optional Keep at most this many blocks (default: configured HAYBA_MEMORY_MAX_COUNT)
max_age_days number Optional Delete blocks older than this many days (default: configured HAYBA_MEMORY_MAX_AGE_DAYS)

memory_recall

Search memory blocks by keyword against their intent and content, most recent match first. Use when you remember roughly what a past block was about but not its id.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
text string Required Keyword/phrase to search for in intent + content
scope "private" | "shared" Optional
agentRole string Optional Restrict to blocks written by this role
limit integer Optional Max blocks to return (default 10)

memory_write

Write a memory block: an intent, its content, which agent role wrote it, and whether it is private or shared with other agents. Runs bounded retention (age + count) after every write and reports what (if anything) it pruned.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
agentRole string Required Role of the writing agent, e.g. "director", "asset-manager"
scope "private" | "shared" Required "private" = only this agentRole sees it via recall/list filters; "shared" = any role can
intent string Required Short label for what this block is about
content string Required The memory content itself
accessedResources string[] Optional Resource paths/ids touched while forming this memory
tokenCost number Optional Approximate token cost of the content, for budget tracking
provenance object (map) Optional Free-form provenance, e.g. {tool, cursor}
id string Optional Explicit id (default: a generated UUID) — mainly for re-inserting/overwriting a known block
timestamp number Optional Explicit epoch-ms timestamp (default: now) — mainly for import/migration

Animation Blueprints 5

anim_blueprint_add_state

Adds a state to an existing state machine in an animation blueprint. It cannot create the state machine itself — that still needs the AnimGraph editor — so on a blueprint with none it answers 'state machine not found', which is a missing prerequisite rather than a bad request. Compile with anim_blueprint_compile afterwards.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required
state_machine_name string Required From anim_blueprint_get_info. This command does not create state machines — only states inside one that exists.
new_state_name string Required A name already used in that state machine is refused rather than duplicated

anim_blueprint_add_transition

Wires one state to another. The transition is created with no rule, which means it is always taken — pair it with anim_blueprint_set_condition unless you actually want an unconditional transition. Pass state_machine_name when two state machines might share a state name.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required
from_state string Required
to_state string Required
state_machine_name string Optional Optional — without it the states are searched for across every state machine, which is ambiguous if two share a state name

anim_blueprint_compile

Compiles an ANIMATION blueprint (ABP) — the animation state-machine asset, not an ordinary class. Reports the compiler errors and warnings. Every anim_blueprint_* write leaves the asset needing this, and an uncompiled ABP keeps running its previously generated class, so state-machine edits look like they did nothing.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required

anim_blueprint_get_info

Reads an animation blueprint's state machines, their states and transitions, and its variables. Call it before any of the anim_blueprint_* writers: they address a state machine BY NAME, and this is the only way to learn the names — a freshly created anim blueprint has none at all.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Object path of a UAnimBlueprint

anim_blueprint_set_condition

Sets the rule on an existing transition, identified either by its id or by the pair of states it joins. A transition with no rule fires immediately, so this is what turns a wired-up state machine into one that behaves. Compile afterwards to find out whether the expression resolved.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required
condition_expression string Required The rule to drive the transition
transition_id string Optional From anim_blueprint_add_transition. Use this, or from_state + to_state.
from_state string Optional
to_state string Optional

Plugin command. hayba_invoke passes it straight to the editor plugin. Also answers to asset_browse.

Assets and content 23

asset_create_folder

Create a Content Browser folder (make_directory). Idempotent: a no-op that reports already_existed:true when the folder is already present. Use before authoring/importing assets into a new path.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Content path of the folder to create, e.g. "/Game/Meshes/Rocks"

asset_delete

Permanently delete content assets, verifying on the FILESYSTEM that each file is gone. Pass `paths` to delete a set in one call. READ deleted_count, not requested — it counts .uasset files actually removed. NEVER verify a delete with does_asset_exist or asset_search: the asset registry can report an asset gone while its file is still on disk, and that is exactly how a batch delete reports success for files it never removed. Assets the registry has lost but whose files remain are reported as ORPHANED and must be removed from disk directly.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Optional Object path of one asset to delete, e.g. /Game/Foo/MF_X.MF_X
paths string[] Optional Several assets in one call. Prefer this over looping — one call reports which ones actually went.

asset_duplicate

Copy an asset to a new path. Use this to derive a variant rather than editing the original in place.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
source_path string Required
destination_path string Required

asset_fix_redirectors

Collapse the redirector stubs left behind by renames and moves. USE_WHEN: after a batch of asset_rename / asset_move calls — redirectors that survive into a cook are wasted work and confuse later reference lookups.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Optional Folder to scan, e.g. "/Game/UI". Omit to scan the whole project.

asset_get_dependencies

What this asset pulls in — everything that must exist for it to load. USE_WHEN: working out why an asset drags in a large cook, or what to migrate alongside it. NOT_WHEN: you want what depends on IT (asset_get_referencers).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Asset path whose dependencies to list

asset_get_info

Read one asset's metadata (class, path, size, optional thumbnail) by exact path. Use asset_search when you do not yet know the path.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required
include_thumbnails boolean Optional
thumbnail_size integer Optional

asset_get_referencers

WHAT BREAKS IF I DELETE OR RENAME THIS? Lists every asset that references the given one. USE_WHEN: before asset_delete, asset_rename or asset_move — a reference you did not know about becomes a broken link that surfaces much later. NOT_WHEN: you want what the asset itself needs (asset_get_dependencies).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Asset path to look up, e.g. "/Game/UI/T_Panel" or "/Game/UI/T_Panel.T_Panel"

asset_get_references

Both directions of an asset reference graph in one call. Note the lists may be truncated — `capped: true` says so. Prefer the single-direction tools when you need an exact count.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Asset path to inspect

asset_get_source_path

Read an imported asset's reimport source-file path(s) from its AssetImportData — the "where did this come from on disk" question, ahead of a reimport or a broken-source fixup. Probes get_first_filename / extract_filenames / source_data across asset types; returns source_paths:[] when the asset carries no import data (procedural/native assets).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
asset_path string Required Content path of the imported asset, e.g. "/Game/Meshes/SM_Rock"

asset_import

Fail-closed, single-file native import. It pins the fixed connector-cache ancestor/file handles, enforces kind-specific size+magic policy and an exact factory, refuses collisions/overwrite, then discards callback-returned UObject pointers and re-resolves the exact registry path/class/package. Successful imports are normally dirty_in_memory: follow with asset_save on the returned exact path. These checks reduce exposure but do NOT prove crafted files safe for an in-process UE parser; untrusted remote files still require an isolated sanitizer. Future connector continuation additionally requires an opaque single-use grant bound to one enumerated file; directory assertions are not authority.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
source_file string Required One absolute regular file below the fixed OS-temp/hayba-asset-connectors source/request cache. Links, reparse points, hardlinks, device/UNC paths, traversal, and files outside that authority are rejected.
destination_path string Required Canonical /Game folder. The exact asset name is the strict ASCII source basename; an existing registry/live/disk package is refused, never overwritten.
asset_type string Required Exact type intent: texture for PNG/JPEG, sound_wave for WAV, or static_mesh for binary FBX. glTF/GLB/OBJ/USD and dependency-reading formats are rejected.

asset_inspect

AssetRegistry metadata for one asset: class, dirty flag, dependency/referencer counts. Read before edit/delete to avoid surprises. Differs from the legacy asset_get_info (C++-backed single-asset info, may see engine-only fields) and from asset_registry_query (bulk discovery/pagination) — use this when you already know the asset path and want its dependency graph. Optional preparation_policy adds evidence and requested/resolved preparation decisions without mutation.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
asset_path string Required Content path of the asset, e.g. "/Game/Meshes/SM_Rock"
preparation_policy object Optional Inspect preparation decisions and native evidence for a StaticMesh

asset_move

Move an asset to another folder, keeping references working. Leaves a redirector behind; asset_fix_redirectors cleans those up.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Current asset path
target_dir string Required Destination folder, e.g. "/Game/UI/Icons". The asset keeps its name.

asset_open_editor

Open the asset editor tab(s) for one or more assets (AssetEditorSubsystem.open_editor_for_assets) — pure UI focus, surfaces the asset for the user. Reports which paths were missing.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
asset_paths string[] Required Content paths of assets whose editor tabs to open

asset_prepare

Inspect and apply supported StaticMesh preparation policies, retaining partial work and unsupported capability results.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
assetPath string Required
policy object Required

asset_registry_query

Native read-only AssetRegistry query by exact class, asset-name substring, and/or content-path prefix, with deterministic pagination.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
class_filter string Optional Exact asset class name, e.g. "StaticMesh"
name_contains string Optional Case-insensitive asset-name substring
path_prefix string Optional
recursive boolean Optional Default: true.
limit integer Optional Default: 50.
offset integer Optional Default: 0.

asset_rename

Rename an asset in place, fixing up references rather than breaking them. Leaves a redirector behind; asset_fix_redirectors cleans those up. USE_WHEN: the name is wrong. NOT_WHEN: it belongs in another folder (asset_move).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Current asset path
new_name string Required New asset name only — not a path. The asset stays in its current folder.

asset_save

Save dirty packages to disk. With asset_paths: saves each (only if dirty) and reports per-asset success — ok:false when ANY named path fails to save (surfaced in failed[] + warnings[]). Without: flushes ALL dirty map+content packages in one call. The write counterpart to editor_get_state's dirty_packages read. Idempotent (re-saving unchanged bytes is a no-op).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
asset_paths string[] Optional Specific asset paths to save. When omitted, all dirty content packages are saved.

asset_validate

Run the editor data-validation rules over an asset or folder and return the errors and warnings. USE_WHEN: confirming an asset is sound before building on it. NOT_WHEN: checking UI layout — ui_validate is the tool for that.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Asset or folder path to validate

content_browser_sync

Reveal + select assets in the Content Browser (UI focus). Probes sync_browser_to_objects then the AssetTools fallback; degrades to a structured error if neither exists.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
asset_paths string[] Required Content paths to reveal + select in the Content Browser

content_validate

CHECK PROJECT CONTENT AGAINST MEMORY AND PERFORMANCE BUDGETS: oversized textures, compression that contradicts the asset name, non-power-of-two dimensions, UI textures outside the UI group, meshes with no LODs, excessive material slots, unreferenced meshes. Judged per strictness (relaxed/standard/strict) with every threshold justified in the hint. Reports what it did NOT examine — the audits only cover the heaviest N assets, so a clean result is scoped, never a claim about the whole project. NOT_WHEN: checking a UI screen (ui_validate).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
strictness "relaxed" | "standard" | "strict" Optional Override the configured asset strictness. relaxed = only the extreme; standard = normal budgets; strict = tight budgets plus hygiene notes.
top_n integer Optional How many of the heaviest assets to judge, per type. Default 25. Anything outside this window is NOT examined, and the response says so.
include "textures" | "meshes"[] Optional Which audits to run. Defaults to both.
rule_ids string[] Optional Run only these rules, by id.

data_create

Create and persist a concrete, current UDataAsset subclass after bounded path/name/class preflight. MarkPackageDirty and SaveLoadedAsset are callback boundaries: no raw creation pointer crosses either one, and the target path/class is freshly re-resolved before save and again afterward. Inspect ok, dirty_marked, pre_save_re_resolved, save_attempted, saved (present only when attempted), target_re_resolved, and dirty_known. If any identity, dirty-mark, save, or final readback fact is not trustworthy, nested ok:false plus data_create_unknown_outcome makes the top-level response unknown_outcome; query the exact path before retrying.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required
name string Required
class_name string Required must inherit UDataAsset

data_get

Read a bounded property snapshot from a DataAsset. Always inspect reflection_complete, reflection_truncated, properties_omitted_at_least, unsupported_values, and large_integers_as_strings before treating it as complete. Set/map item counts and physical sparse-slot ranges are both capped before iteration, so a small live count cannot hide an unbounded hole scan. Integers outside the exact JSON-number range are decimal strings, never rounded. Soft, weak, lazy, and soft-class wrapper references are reported unsupported/partial instead of falsely serializing an unloaded non-null path as null. Properties with native getters or setters are also unsupported/partial: raw bytes may not be their logical value, and invoking an accessor would execute unaudited code.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required

data_set

Write one bounded scalar property on a DataAsset by name, then inspect copy_completed, ok, verified, target_re_resolved, dirty_marked, dirty_known, dirty (when known), and observed_value or observed_value_omitted. Only exact built-in numeric, enum, bool, string, and name property classes without native getters/setters are accepted and assigned through direct typed setters; JsonValueToUProperty and ImportText are never entered. Fixed arrays, dynamic containers, structs (including user-defined structs), wrapper/object references, interfaces, delegates, optionals, text, field paths, SkipSerialization fields, accessor-backed fields, custom property subclasses, and every other extensible type are refused before staging. Staging and all property pointers end before dirty notification; the command then re-resolves the target/class/property and repeats the accessor/schema gate before fresh bounded readback. It deliberately skips transactions, UObject editor hooks, and persistence. save_requested is always false. If any final identity/verification/dirty fact is untrustworthy, nested ok:false plus stable error makes the top-level response unknown_outcome with mandatory readback; ErrorsOnly cannot hide it.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required
property_name string Required
value any Required

Automation tests 4

test_cancel

Cancels only the tagged UnrealEditor-Cmd child owned by the matching active test_run job. It never enumerates or terminates arbitrary editor processes.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
job_id string Required Active owned-child test_run job id

test_get_log

Full entries (errors + warnings) from the last test_run, not just the pass/fail counts. Read this when a test failed and you need the actual assertion text rather than a tally.

No parameters.

test_list

Enumerate registered automation tests via FAutomationTestFramework directly (no controller/session-frontend needed). Name-substring filtering: pass filter_pattern (or its alias filter); the response echoes the applied filter so a dropped param is visible.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
filter_pattern string Optional Substring filter on display name or full path (alias: filter)
filter string Optional Alias of filter_pattern — substring filter on display name or full path. Accepted because it is the spelling callers reach for; it used to be silently ignored and the call returned all ~7000 engine tests.
category string Optional Full-path prefix filter, e.g. 'Hayba.Socket'

test_run

JOB ENVELOPE (async, non-freezing): unknown project, engine, plugin, and future Hayba tests default to a tagged owned UnrealEditor-Cmd child. Only exact lifecycle-audited pure Hayba contracts use the serving editor's core ticker. Empty or unmatched selections fail closed instead of producing a false green. Poll build_status for structured counts plus execution_mode, child PID/token, exit code, report validity, crash, timeout, cancellation, output-bound, and crash-artifact-count evidence. A crash or never-started child is failed, never skipped. Only one run may be active.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
test_names any[] Optional Test names/full-paths to run, or the single string 'all'. Accepts a string or array.
filter_pattern string Optional Case-insensitive substring selector on display name or full path (alias: filter). Use without explicit test_names.
filter string Optional Alias of filter_pattern. Use the same selector object returned by a successful test_list discovery call.
category string Optional Case-insensitive full-path prefix selector, e.g. 'LanternPuzzle'. Use without explicit test_names.
smoke_only boolean Optional Restrict to SmokeFilter-tagged tests
timeout_seconds number Optional For allowlisted in-process tests: per-test latent drain timeout. For owned-child runs: total process deadline, default 300 and hard-capped at 900 seconds.

Behavior trees 4

bt_add_node

Adds one node to a behavior tree. Build a tree root-first: a composite with no parent_guid becomes the root, then tasks and further composites hang off it by guid. The kind/class mismatch checks are strict on purpose, since a decorator quietly added as a task is the kind of thing you only notice when the AI misbehaves. Marks the asset dirty; asset_save to keep it.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Object path of the UBehaviorTree
node_kind string Required composite | task | decorator | service. Checked against the class — asking for a composite and naming a task class is an error, not a guess.
node_class_name string Required UBTNode subclass, e.g. BTComposite_Selector, BTTask_Wait, BTDecorator_Blackboard
parent_guid string Optional From bt_get_info. Omitted on a composite means it becomes the root; decorators and services always need a composite parent.

bt_compile

Compiles the tree and reports what the compiler said. Read the warnings, not just ok: a tree with no blackboard asset compiles successfully and then does nothing useful at runtime, and that case is reported as a warning rather than an error.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required

bt_connect

Re-parents an existing node under a composite. It refuses to connect a node to itself and refuses an edge that would make a cycle, so a tree cannot be wired into one that never terminates. Ordering among siblings is the order children were added, and that order is execution order for a Selector or Sequence.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required
parent_guid string Required Must be a composite — only composites take children
child_guid string Required A composite or a task

bt_get_info

Reads a behavior tree's whole node graph plus its blackboard keys. Call it first: bt_add_node and bt_connect address nodes by the guids this returns, and those guids come from node object paths rather than being stored, so they stay valid between calls without any bookkeeping on your side.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Object path of a UBehaviorTree

Plugin command. hayba_invoke passes it straight to the editor plugin.

Binds a widget or component event (Button OnClicked, a collision overlap) as an event node — the Details panel's '+' next to an event. Idempotent. Exposed to agents as ui_bind_event; kept agent_callable so hayba_invoke can reach component events too.

graph_name string Optional
x number Optional
y number Optional

Add a component of a given class to a Blueprint's component tree. Changes are staged — blueprint_compile applies them, and nothing takes effect in the level until it does.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required

component_name string Required

blueprint_add_custom_event

Adds a custom event to a blueprint's event graph: a named entry point that timers, other blueprints and the blueprint itself can call. Wire its OutputDelegate pin into a Set Timer by Event node to run it on a timer. Staged until blueprint_compile.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required
event_name string Required Unused on this blueprint across events, functions and inherited functions
inputs any[] Optional Event parameters as [{"name", "type"}] using the blueprint_add_variable type grammar
graph_name string Optional An event graph; omit for the main one
x number Optional
y number Optional

blueprint_add_event

Adds (or returns the existing) override event node such as BeginPlay, Tick, EndPlay, or a widget's Construct/PreConstruct — the entry points a Blueprint starts from. Idempotent: a second call returns the node already there.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required
event_name string Required An event the parent class lets blueprints implement, as the node shows it ("BeginPlay", "Event Construct", "Tick", "EndPlay") or its function name ("ReceiveBeginPlay")
graph_name string Optional
x number Optional
y number Optional

blueprint_add_function

Adds a function graph to a blueprint, with an optional signature (inputs, outputs, pure), and recompiles. Every parameter type is checked before the graph is created, so a bad type refuses the whole function rather than leaving a half-built one. Build the body with blueprint_add_node using graph_name = the function name.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Object path of the UBlueprint
function_name string Required Must be unused on this blueprint (case-insensitive); a taken name is refused before anything is created
inputs any[] Optional Parameters as [{"name", "type"}] — type uses the blueprint_add_variable grammar (float, text, object:<class path>, array<...>)
outputs any[] Optional Return values as [{"name", "type"}]; creates the function's result node
pure boolean Optional Mark the function pure (no exec pins; called wherever its output is read)

blueprint_add_node

Stages a standard event-graph node and returns its GUID plus exact pins. timer_by_function creates K2_SetTimer; set its Object, FunctionName, Time and Looping pins before compile. For entry points use blueprint_add_event (BeginPlay, Construct), blueprint_add_custom_event, or ui_bind_event (widget events).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required
graph_name string Optional Graph to place the node in; omit for the main event graph, or pass a function name to build its body
node_type string Required call_function, branch, select, timer_by_function, variable_get, variable_set, cast, sequence (option_count = number of then_N outputs), self (a reference to this blueprint), or create_widget (class_path = the widget class, ending _C)
function_name string Optional
class_path string Optional The class a call_function belongs to (omit for this blueprint's own functions), the target type of a cast, or the widget class of create_widget
variable_name string Optional
option_count integer Optional select: number of options; sequence: number of outputs (2-32)
x number Optional
y number Optional

blueprint_add_variable

Add a member variable to a Blueprint and recompile. Object, class and struct references are resolved when added, so a mistyped path is refused with the path in the message instead of compiling into a broken pin. Refuses a name the blueprint already has.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required
variable_name string Required
variable_type string Required bool, int, int64, float, string, name, text, byte, vector, rotator, transform, linear_color, vector2d, object:<class path>, class:<class path>, soft_object:<class path>, soft_class:<class path>, struct:<struct path>, enum:<enum path>, or array<any of those>. Blueprint classes end in _C, e.g. object:/Game/UI/WBP_Menu.WBP_Menu_C
default_value string Optional Default in Unreal's text form, e.g. "0.2", "true", "Title". For arrays and structs set the default afterwards with blueprint_set_defaults.

blueprint_compile

Compile a Blueprint and report errors. Every blueprint_* edit is staged until this runs, so call it before expecting a change to exist — and read `errors`, because a failed compile leaves the old class in place. With save true, a read-only package is refused before compiling with code package_read_only and data.make_writable_hint; nothing changes. Take the file's lock and retry, or pass save:false.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required
save boolean Optional Defaults true. Pass false to compile without saving, e.g. for a read-only package.

blueprint_connect_nodes

Wires exec or data pins using GUIDs and exact pin names from blueprint_inspect_graph/add_node. The K2 schema rejects invalid type or direction connections.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription

to_node string Required
to_pin string Required

package_path is the full intended asset path (trailing component = asset name), matching material_create. The handler derives the directory via FPackageName::GetLongPackagePath and re-composes <dir>/<name> so the asset lands at the standard /Game/Dir/Name.Name. A parent of /Script/Engine.BlueprintFunctionLibrary creates a real function library (static functions callable from any blueprint); check blueprint_type in the reply.

blueprint_get_info

build_cook

No parameters.

Reader for the async job registry shared by build_project / build_cook / build_generate_project_files / test_run. Reads the job entry under its lock by job_id and returns its current status/result. Test jobs expose untruncated scalar pass/fail/skip totals plus a structured test_results object; malformed test results fail closed. Poll this after a build_* / test_run call returns { job_id, status:'running' }.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
