Splines 5

spline_add_point

Append a point to a spline, or insert it at `index`. Returns the new point_count, which is the index bound for spline_set_point and spline_remove_point.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required
location any[] Required
index integer Optional

spline_create

Create a spline actor at a location. The spline starts empty — add its shape with spline_add_point. Splines drive roads, rivers, fences, cable runs and PCG spline samplers.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
label string Required
location any[] Optional

spline_get_info

Read a spline's point count, total length and every point's position. The read half of spline editing — call it before set/remove so indices refer to what you think they do.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required

spline_remove_point

Delete a spline point by index. Indices of later points SHIFT DOWN afterwards, so remove from the end backwards when deleting several.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required
index integer Required

spline_set_point

Move an existing spline point to a new location, addressed by index. Use spline_get_info first to see the current points — an out-of-range index fails rather than appending.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_id string Required
index integer Required
location any[] Required

Static meshes 12

mesh_audit

WHICH MESHES ARE COSTING FRAME TIME: static meshes with LOD0 triangle counts, LOD count, material slot count and how many things reference them. USE_WHEN: a scene is heavy and you need to know where the triangles and draw calls actually are.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
top_n integer Optional How many of the heaviest meshes to return. Default 25, max 500.

mesh_extract

Reads back mesh geometry + topology health numerically (welds/winding/holes a screenshot can't confirm). Primary source is actor_label to UDynamicMeshComponent (e.g. PCG grammar shell). Stats are over the whole mesh; raw arrays are opt-in and bounded. For a verdict-only call use mesh_topology_stats (arrays forced off).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_label string Optional Editor actor label; reads its UDynamicMeshComponent (primary source for PCG dynamic-mesh output). Provide this OR path, not both.
component_index number Optional Which UDynamicMeshComponent on the actor (default 0)
component_name string Optional Match the dynamic mesh component by name instead of index
path string Optional UStaticMesh asset path (/Game/...) — alternative source (render data: counts + bounds + optional arrays)
lod number Optional StaticMesh LOD to read (default 0); ignored for dynamic mesh
include_triangles boolean Optional Include the triangles index array [[i,j,k],...] (bounded by max_elements)
include_positions boolean Optional Include the vertices array [[x,y,z],...] (bounded by max_elements)
include_normals boolean Optional Include computed per-triangle face normals (dynamic mesh only)
max_elements number Optional Hard cap on emitted array elements (default 2000); stats are always over the whole mesh
bbox_min any[] Optional [x,y,z] local-space AABB min; with arrays requested, only emit triangles whose centroid is inside the box
bbox_max any[] Optional [x,y,z] local-space AABB max

mesh_get_bounds

Read a StaticMesh's local bounds: origin, box extent, sphere radius, and min/max corners (cm). The cheap standalone sizing readback (BoxSphereBounds), distinct from the C++ mesh_get_info bounds used by the physical-asset baker.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
asset_path string Required Content path of the StaticMesh

mesh_get_info

Plugin command. hayba_invoke passes it straight to the editor plugin.

Triangle and vertex counts, the LOD chain with its screen sizes, material slots and local bounds for one static mesh. Called from TS by the physical-asset baker and world_generate for bounds, so it is documented here rather than surfaced as its own agent tool: agents should reach for mesh_get_bounds / mesh_get_lods / mesh_get_materials, which split the same information and do not load the asset whole.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Object path of a UStaticMesh, e.g. /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube.Cube

mesh_get_lods

Report a StaticMesh's LOD count and per-LOD triangle/vertex counts (StaticMeshEditorSubsystem, falling back to EditorStaticMeshLibrary). Degrades to lod_count with null tri/vert when the per-LOD getters are unavailable on this build.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
asset_path string Required Content path of the StaticMesh

mesh_get_materials

List a StaticMesh's material slots: slot index, slot name, and the assigned material asset path (from static_materials). The map an agent reads before mesh_set_material_slot.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
asset_path string Required Content path of the StaticMesh

mesh_get_sockets

List a StaticMesh's named sockets with relative transform (location/rotation/scale) — the attachment points an agent needs before snapping child actors onto a mesh. Reads the `sockets` property defensively.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
asset_path string Required Content path of the StaticMesh, e.g. "/Game/Meshes/SM_Rock"

mesh_list

Enumerate static meshes from the asset registry without loading any of them — the cheap way to find something to place or inspect. Always pass path_prefix on a real project unless you actually want engine content in the results. Exact subclasses only, so a mesh subclass is not listed.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path_prefix string Optional Keep only assets whose object path starts with this, e.g. /Game/LanternPuzzle. Omitted means every static mesh the registry knows, engine content included.

mesh_list_dynamic

Enumerate every UDynamicMeshComponent in the editor level with tri/vert/material counts — replaces the hand-rolled 'loop all actors to DynamicMeshComponent to tris' python_run for inspecting PCG/grammar output. Pair with mesh_topology_stats(actor_label=...) for a full weld/manifold verdict on a specific one.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
label_contains string Optional Only list components on actors whose label contains this substring

mesh_set_lod

Sets a LOD's screen size (and optionally its reduction target) on a static mesh, then rebuilds it. Returns ok, path, lod_index, screen_size and reduction_percent_triangles readback. Plan Mode gated and transactional. Editor-only, and it modifies the asset — save it afterwards. It REFUSES a mesh with any zero-UV LOD, because the rebuild would hit an engine assert and take the editor down with it; that refusal is a real limit of the asset, not a bug in this command.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Object path of the UStaticMesh
lod_index number Required Which source model; must be within lod_count from mesh_get_info
screen_size number Required Screen size at which this LOD takes over
reduction_percent_triangles number Optional Optional triangle-reduction target for this LOD

mesh_set_material_slot

Assign a material/MaterialInstance asset to a StaticMesh material slot by index, saving the mesh and reading back the applied material path. Probes StaticMeshEditorSubsystem.set_material then the static_materials array. Idempotent set-to-value (assigning the same material twice is the same state). Sets the material ASSET on the slot — use material_* tools to edit the graph.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
asset_path string Required Content path of the StaticMesh to modify
slot_index integer Required Material slot index to set
material_path string Required Content path of the material/MaterialInstance to assign

mesh_topology_stats

Stats-only alias of mesh_extract (raw geometry arrays forced off). Use to get a fast weld/winding/holes verdict: non_manifold_vertices==0 && degenerate_triangles==0 && connected_components==1 && a small explainable boundary_edges == healthy.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
actor_label string Optional Editor actor label; reads its UDynamicMeshComponent
component_index number Optional Which UDynamicMeshComponent (default 0)
component_name string Optional Match component by name instead of index
path string Optional UStaticMesh asset path (alternative source)
lod number Optional StaticMesh LOD (default 0)

Textures 5

texture_audit

WHICH TEXTURES ARE COSTING MEMORY: every Texture2D ranked by resource size, with dimensions, format, LOD group and compression, and a flag where the name implies a role the compression contradicts. USE_WHEN: chasing memory or load times. NOT_WHEN: inspecting one texture you already know about (texture_get_info).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
top_n integer Optional How many of the heaviest textures to return. Default 25, max 500. The scan covers every Texture2D regardless.

texture_get_info

Inspect a Texture2D: dimensions, source/platform format, mip count, compression settings, LOD group, sRGB, never-stream, address modes.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Texture asset path, e.g. /Game/Tex/T_Rock

texture_list

List Texture2D assets, optionally filtered by path prefix.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path_prefix string Optional Only list textures whose path starts with this, e.g. /Game/Tex

texture_set_compression

Set a texture's compression (TC_*) and optionally LOD group + sRGB. Re-imports the texture resource. For other properties (mip gen, max size, filter, address, ...) use texture_set_settings.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Texture asset path
compression_settings string Required TextureCompressionSettings, e.g. Normalmap / Masks / Default (TC_ prefix optional)
lod_group string Optional TextureGroup, e.g. World / WorldNormalMap (TEXTUREGROUP_ prefix optional)
srgb boolean Optional sRGB flag

texture_set_settings

Set any texture properties at once via reflection. Aliases: compression_settings, lod_group, srgb, never_stream, address_x, address_y, mip_gen_settings, max_texture_size, flip_green_channel, filter, virtual_texture_streaming, lod_bias. Any raw UTexture UPROPERTY name also works. Re-imports the resource after applying.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Texture asset path
properties object (map) Required Settings to set, e.g. { compression_settings: "Normalmap", srgb: false, mip_gen_settings: "Sharpen4" }

UMG widgets 31

ui_add_element

Add a widget (Button/TextBlock/Image/panel/…) to an existing Widget Blueprint tree, optionally under a named panel, with slot layout props. Marks the BP structurally modified + dirty.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the target Widget Blueprint
child_class string Required Widget class — short name (Button, TextBlock, CanvasPanel, HorizontalBox, …) or full class path
parent_widget_name string Optional Name of an existing PANEL widget to parent under; defaults to the root panel
name string Optional Name for the new widget (auto-generated if omitted)
slot_props object (map) Optional Slot layout props: x/y/w/h (canvas), fill/padding (box); other keys set on the slot by reflection

ui_bind_event

Make a widget react to input: bind a widget event (Button OnClicked, OnHovered, OnPressed) to an event node in its Widget Blueprint, then wire the node's "then" pin to what should happen. Idempotent - binding again returns the existing node. Expose the widget with ui_set_variable and compile first.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the Widget Blueprint that owns the widget, e.g. /Game/UI/WBP_Title
widget_name string Required The widget whose event fires, e.g. "StartButton". It must be exposed as a variable first (ui_set_variable) and the blueprint compiled.
event_name string Required The event to bind — "OnClicked" for a click. A wrong name is refused with the list of events the widget has.
graph_name string Optional Event graph to place the node in; omit for the main one
x number Optional Node position in the graph
y number Optional Node position in the graph

ui_bind_property

Bind a widget property (Text, ToolTipText, Visibility, bIsEnabled) to a blueprint variable - the designer Bind dropdown. This is how a reusable pure-Blueprint component gets a settable caption without a C++ base class. Omit variable_name to clear the binding.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the target Widget Blueprint
widget_name string Required Widget whose property is being bound (e.g. "Chip_Label"). Marked Is Variable automatically — a binding cannot resolve otherwise.
property_name string Required Bindable property on that widget, WITHOUT the "Delegate" suffix — "Text", "ToolTipText", "Visibility", "bIsEnabled". Rejected with the expected delegate name if the property is not bindable.
variable_name string Optional Blueprint variable to drive the property. Create it first with blueprint_add_variable (type "text" for a Text property). OMIT to CLEAR an existing binding.

ui_build_tree

Build a whole widget subtree from one nested spec - {class, name?, properties?, slot_props?, children?}. One call instead of one ui_add_element per widget. Depth-first in order; on failure the widgets already created are KEPT and named in the error so you can see exactly how far it got.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the target Widget Blueprint
parent_widget_name string Optional Existing panel to build under. Defaults to the root panel.
tree object | object[] Required A node, or an array of sibling nodes, each {class, name?, properties?, slot_props?, children?}. Built depth-first in order. On failure the widgets created before the failing node are KEPT and named in the error.

ui_compile_widget

Compile a Widget Blueprint asset. Returns compilation status (UpToDate/Error/Dirty), warnings, and errors. Optionally save on successful compilation.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the Widget Blueprint to compile
save_on_success boolean Optional Save the package on successful compile Default: false.

ui_copy_style

"Make this look like that one" — copies a working widget's brush (draw_as, resource, margin, tint, size) and text style (font, typeface, size, colour) onto another. Copies STYLE ONLY: slot layout and text content stay the target's, so matching a look cannot wreck a layout. Use dry_run to see what would be copied. USE_WHEN: one widget already looks right. NOT_WHEN: you know the values (ui_set_brush / ui_set_text_style) or want the widget itself (ui_duplicate_element).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Blueprint containing the source widget
from_widget string Required Widget whose style to copy
to_widget string Required Widget to restyle
to_widget_blueprint_path string Optional Blueprint containing the target, when it differs from the source blueprint.
include "brush" | "text"[] Optional Which aspects to copy. Never copies slot layout or text content. Default: ["brush","text"].
dry_run boolean Optional Report what would be copied without writing. Default: false.

ui_create_widget

CREATE A NEW MENU, SCREEN OR HUD as a UMG Widget Blueprint asset — the designer-editable kind an artist can also open. Seeds a root CanvasPanel ready for content. USE_WHEN: starting any new piece of UI. NOT_WHEN: adding to an existing one (ui_add_element / ui_build_tree), or inspecting what a running game is showing (editor_pie_widget_tree).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required UE content package directory, e.g. "/Game/LanternPuzzle/UI"
name string Required Asset name, e.g. "WBP_PuzzlePanel"
parent_class string Optional Parent class (must descend from UserWidget); class path or short name. Defaults to UserWidget.

ui_duplicate_element

Duplicate a widget and its entire subtree, cloning properties and slot layout. The copy and every duplicated descendant are registered as designer variables. Use for repeated rows, cards and list entries.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the target Widget Blueprint
widget_name string Required Name of the widget to duplicate. Its whole subtree is copied.
new_name string Optional Name for the copy. Auto-uniquified from the source name if omitted.
parent_widget_name string Optional Panel to place the copy under. Defaults to the source widget own parent (i.e. a sibling copy).
slot_props object (map) Optional Slot layout overrides for the copy, applied after the source slot layout is cloned.

ui_get_widget_info

Get detailed info about a Widget Blueprint: full widget tree with properties, variable GUIDs, slot layout, and typed property values per widget.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the Widget Blueprint to inspect
include_properties boolean Optional Include widget properties in the response Default: true.
include_guid boolean Optional Include GUIDs in the response Default: true.

ui_layout_snapshot

Resolve the real on-screen geometry of every widget by running a Slate prepass on the compiled widget class, plus per-widget font, measured text width and brush facts. This is the measurement layer ui_validate judges. layout_resolved:false means the blueprint could not be instantiated (usually: compile it first) and geometry is absent rather than zero.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the Widget Blueprint to lay out
screen_width number Optional Resolution to lay out at. Defaults to the blueprint’s design-time size.
screen_height number Optional Resolution to lay out at. Defaults to the blueprint’s design-time size.
widget_names string[] Optional Return only these exact widget names. Use this for targeted style/geometry reads on large trees.
offset integer Optional Zero-based widget offset for paginating production-sized trees.
limit integer Optional Widgets to return per page (maximum 50, matching the UE transport limit).

ui_list_widget_blueprints

List the Widget Blueprints that exist in the project, with the _C class path needed to use one as a child widget or as a parent class. Reads the asset registry, so no blueprint is loaded.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Optional Restrict to a content path, e.g. "/Game/UI". Searched recursively.
filter string Optional Case-sensitive substring the asset name must contain

ui_list_widget_types

List UMG widget classes that can be added via ui_add_element or ui_replace_element. Native classes by default; pass include_blueprints to also list your own Widget Blueprint classes, or panels_only to narrow to containers.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
filter string Optional Optional text filter for widget class names

ui_measure_text

Measure a string exactly, through the Slate font measure service, in a widget real font or an explicit one. Returns rendered width/height plus how many characters fit in the box: the actual string, typical mixed-case prose, and the worst case if every glyph were the font widest. Use this to size a label for variable-length runtime text (player names, item names, translations) BEFORE it clips in game.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
text string Required The string to measure
widget_blueprint_path string Optional Measure using this blueprint widget’s actual font. Pair with widget_name.
widget_name string Optional Widget whose font (and, by default, box width) to measure against.
font_asset string Optional Composite UFont asset path. A UFontFace is rejected — Slate cannot measure or render one as text.
font_size number Optional Font size in px. Required when not measuring against a widget.
typeface string Optional Typeface name within the font, e.g. "Bold"
available_width number Optional Box width in px to fit against. Defaults to the widget’s laid-out width when a widget is given.
font_scale number Optional DPI/application scale to measure at Default: 1.

ui_move_element

Reorder a widget among its siblings. Child order is draw order and tab order in box panels. Slot layout is preserved across the move; an out-of-range index is rejected with the valid range.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the target Widget Blueprint
widget_name string Required Name of the widget to reorder
index integer Required New zero-based index among its siblings. Out-of-range values are rejected with the valid range.

ui_query

Return the widget tree of a Widget Blueprint - per-widget name, class, slot, variable GUID and typed properties. Pass name_pattern / class_filter / flatten to get a flat list of matching widgets instead of the whole tree.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Full path of the Widget Blueprint to inspect, e.g. "/Game/LanternPuzzle/UI/WBP_PuzzlePanel"
include_properties boolean Optional Include widget properties in the response Default: false.
include_guid boolean Optional Include GUIDs in the response Default: false.
include_slot boolean Optional Include slot layout info in the response Default: true.
name_pattern string Optional Case-sensitive substring a widget name must contain. Returns a flat `matches` list instead of the tree.
class_filter string Optional Class a widget must be or derive from, e.g. "PanelWidget" for every panel. Returns a flat `matches` list instead of the tree.
flatten boolean Optional Return the flat `matches` list even when no filter is given.

ui_remove_element

Remove a widget from a Widget Blueprint designer tree, together with its whole subtree. Variable GUIDs for every removed descendant are purged, not just the named widget. Removing the root requires an explicit replacement_root.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the target Widget Blueprint
widget_name string Required Name of the widget to remove
replacement_root string Optional If removing the root widget, provide a replacement widget class to become the new root

ui_rename_element

Rename a designer widget, carrying its variable GUID across so existing bindings keep resolving. The widget name IS the variable name the graph and C++ BindWidget use, so this is an API change.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the target Widget Blueprint
widget_name string Required Current name of the widget
new_name string Required New name. Must be unique within this widget tree.

ui_render_widget_to_png

SEE a Widget Blueprint: draws it to a PNG and returns the image inline, with no PIE session and no editor restart. out_path accepts only an optional clean PNG filename; Hayba writes it without overwrite under Saved/Screenshots/Hayba and returns the resolved absolute path. This is how you check fonts, colours, brushes, spacing and overflow in seconds instead of a rebuild-and-play cycle. Read coverage_percent — 0 means the widget drew nothing and the PNG is blank. USE_WHEN: you want to look at the UI. NOT_WHEN: you want numbers (ui_layout_snapshot) or a verdict (ui_validate).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the Widget Blueprint to draw
width integer Optional Render width in px. Defaults to the blueprint’s design-time size.
height integer Optional Render height in px. Defaults to the blueprint’s design-time size.
scale number Optional Multiplies the size, 0.1–4.0. Use 2 to read small text.
out_path string Optional Optional clean PNG filename only. Written without overwrite under Saved/Screenshots/Hayba; omit for a unique filename.
opaque_background boolean Optional Force alpha to 255 (default true). UMG draws onto transparency, and an unmodified alpha channel makes most viewers show the whole image as black. Pass false only when you intend to composite.
inline_image boolean Optional Return the PNG inline so you can actually look at it (default true). Skipped automatically above ~3MB; read out_path in that case.

ui_reparent_element

Move an existing designer widget from its current parent to a new parent panel. Preserves widget instance and GUID. Creates the correct slot class for the new parent.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the target Widget Blueprint
widget_name string Required Name of the widget to reparent
new_parent_name string Required Name of the existing panel widget to reparent under
slot_props object (map) Optional Optional slot layout props for the new parent slot

ui_replace_element

Replace a designer widget with a different class at the same position. Preserves parent, child index, slot layout, and the complete child subtree by default (preserve_children); optionally preserves the name, variable GUID (preserve_guid), and every property the two classes share by name and type (preserve_properties). Set preserve_children:false only to explicitly delete descendants.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the target Widget Blueprint
widget_name string Required Name of the widget to replace
new_class string Required New widget class to replace with (short name or full class path)
new_name string Optional Valid Unreal object name for the replacement widget (defaults to original name)
preserve_guid boolean Optional Preserve the original widget GUID Default: true.
preserve_properties boolean Optional Preserve original widget properties on the replacement Default: false.
preserve_children boolean Optional Preserve and reparent the original child subtree onto the replacement (default true). Set false only to explicitly delete the subtree. Default: true.

ui_save_widget

Save a Widget Blueprint package to disk. Optionally compile before save. Returns whether the save succeeded and whether the package is still dirty.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the Widget Blueprint to save. A read-only package is refused with code package_read_only; see data.make_writable_hint.
compile_first boolean Optional Run compile before saving Default: false.

ui_search_widgets

Search within a Widget Blueprint for widgets matching a name pattern or class filter. Returns matching widget paths and properties.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the Widget Blueprint to search
widget_name_pattern string Optional Case-sensitive substring to match widget names against
widget_class string Optional Filter by widget class. Matches the exact class or any ancestor, so "PanelWidget" returns every panel and "TextBlock" returns TextBlocks and RichTextBlocks that derive from it.
include_properties boolean Optional Include widget properties in each result Default: false.
include_guid boolean Optional Include the designer variable GUID in each result Default: false.

ui_set_brush

Set the brush on an Image or Border widget in a Widget Blueprint: texture/material resource, tint color, draw style, image size, and 9-slice margins.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the target Widget Blueprint
widget_name string Required Name of the Image or Border widget
resource string Optional Texture2D or Material asset path for the brush, e.g. "/Game/LanternPuzzle/UI/Icons/T_LanternIcon"
tint number[] Optional RGBA tint color (0-1)
draw_as "Image" | "Border" | "Box" | "RoundedBox" | "NoDrawType" Optional Brush draw style. Box = 9-slice: the four Margin values fix the corners and the middle stretches — this is what a frame or panel background wants. Image stretches the whole texture. Border draws edges only.
image_size number[] Optional Image size [Width, Height]
margin number[] Optional 9-slice margins [Left, Top, Right, Bottom]
brush_property "Brush" | "Background" Optional Which brush to write. Image widgets use "Brush" (the default); Border widgets expose theirs as "Background". Default: "Brush".

ui_set_default_font

Rewrite every text widget still on an engine default font (Roboto) onto a project font, in one call. New TextBlocks always arrive as /Engine/EngineFonts/Roboto "Bold" and ui_set_text_style only changes the fields you pass — so setting size and colour but forgetting font_asset+typeface silently keeps Roboto and still reports success. Use dry_run first to see what would change. USE_WHEN: a blueprint has the default font anywhere. NOT_WHEN: restyling one widget (ui_set_text_style).

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the Widget Blueprint to sweep
font_asset string Required Composite UFont asset to apply, e.g. "/Game/UI/Fonts/F_LanternBody". Must NOT be a UFontFace.
typeface string Optional Typeface within the font. Defaults to Regular — the engine default is Bold, which reads as emphasis nobody asked for. Default: "Regular".
only_engine_fonts boolean Optional Only rewrite text that is still on an /Engine/ font (the default). Set false to force every text widget onto this font, including ones deliberately styled otherwise. Default: true.
dry_run boolean Optional Report what would change without writing anything. Default: false.

ui_set_property

Set a single arbitrary property on a designer widget by name and value. Typed wrapper around ui_set_widget_properties for the common case of changing one thing.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the target Widget Blueprint
widget_name string Required Name of the widget to set the property on
property_name string Required UE property name to set (e.g. "Text", "ColorAndOpacity", "Visibility")
value string | number | boolean | number[] Required Property value — string, number, boolean, or array of numbers for colors/vectors

ui_set_slot_layout

Set CanvasPanel slot layout on a designer widget: anchors (as `anchors` [minX,minY,maxX,maxY], or `anchors_min`+`anchors_max` [x,y] pairs), `position`, `size`, `alignment`, `z_order`, `auto_size`; box/grid slots take `padding`, `fill`, alignments, row/column. Anchors + position + alignment are committed to the CanvasPanelSlot atomically (one LayoutData write). Unknown parameter names are REJECTED with a validation error rather than silently dropped. For non-Canvas slots use the slot_props field in ui_set_widget_properties.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription

ui_set_widget_properties

Generic tool: set named properties and/or slot layout on a designer widget. Operates on the authoritative WidgetTree (not the generated template). Property values may be nested objects for struct properties (Brush, Font). Reports per-key outcomes: succeeded, failed_properties, unknown_slot_props. NOT transacted - these edits deliberately stay out of the editor undo stack, because the transaction buffer can pin PIE references and crash the editor. Prefer the typed tools (ui_set_property, ui_set_text_style, ui_set_slot_layout) for common operations.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the target Widget Blueprint
widget_name string Required Name of the widget to set properties on
properties object (map) Optional Property values keyed by their real UE property name (e.g. "Text", "ColorAndOpacity", "Font"). Values may be nested objects for struct properties, arrays for colors/vectors, or an asset path string for object references.
slot_props object (map) Optional Layout properties applied to the widget’s PANEL SLOT rather than the widget: canvas (anchors/position/size/alignment/auto_size/z_order), box (fill/padding/alignment), grid (row/column/spans). Keys the slot type does not support come back in unknown_slot_props instead of being silently dropped.

ui_validate

CHECK A SCREEN AGAINST GAME-UI STANDARDS: runs the UI rule catalogue over a real Slate layout and reports precise, actionable findings - text that overflows (and the exact character count at which it does), labels with no room for translation growth, content inside TV title/action-safe margins, touch targets below the platform minimum, overlapping siblings, contrast below WCAG, controls gamepad focus cannot reach, and performance traps. Judged per platform (pc/console/handheld/mobile) and per strictness (relaxed/standard/strict). USE_WHEN: after building or editing a Widget Blueprint, and before calling the screen done. NOT_WHEN: you only need the tree (ui_query) or one measurement (ui_measure_text). Rules that need geometry are reported as SKIPPED when the layout cannot be resolved - never as passing.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
widget_blueprint_path string Required Full path of the Widget Blueprint to validate
platform "pc" | "console" | "handheld" | "mobile" Optional Which conventions to judge against. "console" applies TV safe areas and the 28px legibility floor; "mobile" applies 44px touch targets; "handheld" sits between them. Default: "pc".
strictness "relaxed" | "standard" | "strict" Optional Override the configured UI strictness for this run. relaxed = only what is broken; standard = plus UI conventions; strict = plus house-style polish. Defaults to the validator setting.
screen_width number Optional Resolution to evaluate at. Defaults to the blueprint design size.
screen_height number Optional Resolution to evaluate at. Defaults to the blueprint design size.
rule_ids string[] Optional Run only these rules, by id.
persist boolean Optional Write the findings to the validator history so they appear in the editor Validation panel. Set false for a read-only check that leaves no trace. Default: true.

Unreal docs 4

docs_lookup_api

CHECK A PROPERTY OR FUNCTION EXISTS BEFORE YOU USE IT. Lists the real properties of a class (name, C++ type, category, tooltip, whether it is editable and blueprint-visible) and functions (blueprint-callable, event). USE_WHEN: before setting a property by name or calling a function — a wrong name is otherwise a silent no-op or a failed edit. Pass include_inherited when a member you expected is missing; it is usually declared on a parent.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Class path or name, e.g. "/Script/UMG.TextBlock" or "TextBlock".
include_inherited boolean Optional Include members inherited from parent classes. Off by default because the inherited surface of a UObject is large; turn it on when a member you expect is missing — it is often declared on a parent. Default: false.

docs_lookup_class

Inspect a UE class in the running editor: full inheritance chain, class flags, and how many properties and functions it has. USE_WHEN: confirming a class exists and what it derives from before using it as a parent or a cast target.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
path string Required Class path or name, e.g. "/Script/UMG.UserWidget", "UserWidget", or "TextBlock". Resolved against the LIVE editor, so it reflects the engine version and plugins actually loaded.

docs_search

FIND THE REAL NAME OF A UE CLASS instead of guessing. Substring search over every class loaded in the running editor. USE_WHEN: you are about to write a class name from memory. NOT_WHEN: you already have the exact path.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
query string Required Substring to match against class names, case-insensitive. "Widget", "Landscape", "StaticMesh".
kind "class" | "all" Optional What to search. Currently classes; "all" is reserved for future kinds. Default: "class".

query_ue_docs

SEARCH THE INDEXED UE C++ API BEFORE GENERATING CODE. Returns signatures, declaring types, include paths, short source docs and explicit deprecation metadata from the configured versioned Engine/Source database. USE_WHEN: you need source-level intent or want to avoid a deprecated API. NOT_WHEN: you need properties reflected by the currently loaded editor; use docs_lookup_api. Search is deterministic keyword mode; semantic search is reported unavailable until an embedding corpus is installed.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
query string Required UE C++ API name or concept. Examples: "FActorIterator", "iterate actors", "deprecated navigation".
class_filter string Optional Optional declaring class/type filter, for example "AActor" or "FActorIterator".
kind_filter "class" | "struct" | "enum" | "function" Optional Optional symbol kind. Omit to search classes, structs, enums and functions together.
mode "keyword" Optional Search mode. This database currently supports honest deterministic keyword search only. Default: "keyword".
limit integer Optional Maximum results, from 1 to 50. Default: 20.

CATCHES SILENT WRONGNESS YOU CANNOT SEE: runs the validator rules over the current scene and returns concrete post-condition findings — actors floating above ground, interpenetrating meshes, off-grid/mis-scaled placements, missing expected results, and PLUMB constraint violations. validator_strictness

Read or set validation strictness. Three modes — relaxed (only what is broken), standard (plus established conventions), strict (plus house-style polish) — set globally or per category (ui, pcg, landscape, material, blueprint, python, asset, general). A rule declares the lowest mode at which it fires, so raising strictness only ever adds findings. Call with no arguments to read the current settings. Persists to .scratch/validator-config.json, the same file the editor Configure panel reads.

Water 11

water_body_inspect

Deep read-back of one water body: component validity (catches placeholder-stub spawns), wave presence, water/underwater material refs, affects-landscape flag, owning zone and bounds. The paired read for validate-before/after-mutate. Property/material reflection is probed with alternate names; anything unresolved surfaces in warnings[].

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription

water_body_lake_create

Spawn an AWaterBodyLake at a water level with an optional footprint radius and label. Lakes are a core terrain-water feature. NON_IDEMPOTENT; supports dry_run. NOTE: closed-spline shoreline shaping is UNCERTAIN-API and deferred — the body spawns with its default footprint and a warning is surfaced. Degrades cleanly if Water is off.

Paginated introspection of all water bodies in the level: class, label, owning-zone binding (AABB containment), bounds and whether waves are attached. The inspection-first read to call before any water mutate. Degrades cleanly to a plugin-disabled envelope if the Water plugin is off.

Spawn an AWaterBodyOcean at a world location with an optional scale and label, and confirm an optional owning WaterZone (zones bind bodies by overlap). The single most common worldbuilding water op — an outcome verb over raw actor_spawn. NON_IDEMPOTENT (each call spawns a new actor); supports dry_run. Degrades to a plugin-disabled envelope if Water is off.

label string Optional Optional actor label
dry_run boolean Optional Plan without spawning Default: false.

water_body_river_create

Spawn an AWaterBodyRiver following a world-space path (>=2 points). Rivers are the hardest water body to author by hand — this hides the spline wiring. NON_IDEMPOTENT; supports dry_run. SET-SUCCESS: surfaces spline_applied (whether the WaterSplineComponent point write actually ran — UNCERTAIN-API); per-point width/depth/velocity metadata is deferred with a warning. Degrades cleanly if Water is off.

water_check_plugin

THE honest gate for the water pack: probe whether the Water plugin is enabled (WaterBodyOcean/WaterZone classes present), whether its editor subsystem is ready, and report version/enable-list. Returns a STRUCTURED {enabled,...} result and NEVER throws — call this first so an agent gets an actionable enable hint instead of an AttributeError. Plugin version is UNCERTAIN-API (no python reflection) and stays null with a warning.

No parameters.

water_validate

PLUMB-style quantified check of the water scene: bodies present but no WaterZone, bodies outside every zone (silent render drop), wave steepness out of [0..1], inverted wavelength range, multiple oceans. Returns green/red status + categorised findings with severity + a fix hint; ok:false only on errors. The closed-loop correctness engine for water (the worldbuilding moat). autofix not implemented this wave.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
scope "level" Optional Validation scope (only level supported this wave) Default: "level".

water_waves_inspect

Read a body's wave setup: generator type, num_waves, wavelength range, steepness, seed, wind direction and attached WaterWavesAsset. The paired read for the most-tuned water parameter. Generator + property reflection is UNCERTAIN-API in 5.7 — probed with alternate names; anything unresolved is null with a warning, never guessed.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
body_path string Required Actor path or label of the water body

water_waves_set_gerstner

Configure a body's GerstnerWaterWaveGeneratorSimple (num_waves, wavelength range, steepness, wind direction, seed) — the primary knob for ocean look, with sane-range arg validation. SET-SUCCESS: the generator + every property setter is UNCERTAIN-API and returns void, so applied:true is reported ONLY when the generator resolved AND at least one setter ran without raising; otherwise ok:false + applied:false + a warning (never ok:true with an unapplied change). fields_applied lists exactly which knobs took. Idempotent set-to-value.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
body_path string Required Actor path or label of the water body
num_waves integer Optional Number of Gerstner waves
min_wavelength number Optional Minimum wavelength
max_wavelength number Optional Maximum wavelength
steepness number Optional Wave steepness [0..1]
wind_dir number Optional Dominant wind/wave direction (degrees)
seed integer Optional Random seed
dry_run boolean Optional Resolve the generator without applying Default: false.

water_zone_create

Spawn an AWaterZone (optionally sized + render-target resolution) to bound water bodies — bodies do NOT render without a covering zone (5.7 bounded zones). NON_IDEMPOTENT; supports dry_run. SET-SUCCESS: surfaces extent_applied/resolution_applied for the UNCERTAIN-API property writes. Degrades cleanly if Water is off.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription

extent number[] Optional Zone XY extent [x,y] in world units
resolution number[] Optional Water-info render-target resolution [x,y]
label string Optional Optional actor label
dry_run boolean Optional Plan without spawning Default: false.

water_zone_inspect

Read a WaterZone: bounds, water-info render-target resolution, LOD far distance, which bodies it covers (AABB containment) and which bodies in the level are orphaned (covered by NO zone — the silent "body outside zone" rendering drop). Property reflection is UNCERTAIN-API; probed with alternate names.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription

Build an environment from a natural-language biome description. Parses the prompt into layers (canopy/rock/undergrowth/groundcover), resolves one of the PROJECT'S OWN StaticMeshes per layer, plans a deterministic seeded scatter across an area actor, then PLUMB-VALIDATES and auto-corrects every instance IN MEMORY (grounded, non-interpenetrating) before spawning — "scatter and prove", not scatter-and-hope. Inspect the open Unreal world and return normalized capability and readiness facts.

world_query

Find loaded Unreal source objects in one exact captured mesh tile by an authored tag, folder, actor class, or mesh asset. Optionally compare each match to one reference source ID or authored fact using a typed candidate relation from sampled point bounds. First use world_tile_capture, then pass its tile_id and capture_id as expected_capture_id here. Returns canonical actor/component/instance provenance, point evidence, and coverage gaps. A partial capture cannot prove absence; this does not infer visual labels, collision, visibility, gameplay quality, or a production budget verdict.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
tile_id string Required Tile ID returned by world_tile_capture.
expected_capture_id string Required The exact capture ID returned by world_tile_capture; never substitute a newer capture silently.
target object Required Exact authored tag, folder, actor class, or mesh asset to find. This is not an inferred visual label.
reference_source_node_id string Optional Canonical source node ID of the object used as the spatial reference.
reference object Optional Alternatively, exact authored fact selecting reference sources. The query compares matching targets to these references.
relation_kind "near_sampled_bounds" | "above_sampled_bounds" | "sampled_bounds_overlap" | "sampled_bounds_contains" Optional Provisional relation computed from sampled point bounds, not collision or visibility.
near_threshold_cm number Optional Maximum sampled-bounds gap for near relation, in Unreal centimeters.
above_minimum_gap_cm number Optional
above_maximum_gap_cm number Optional
offset integer Optional Default: 0.
limit integer Optional Default: 32.

world_semantic_snapshot

Inspect three separate loaded-world observations: mesh hierarchy and spatial clusters (source=mesh), CPU mesh point-cloud tiles linked to actor/component/instance sources, compact authored semantic groups, and spatial relations (source=mesh_tile), or first-visible editor-camera depth (source=view_depth). Use world_tile_capture to capture a tile on demand. For mesh_tile, pass its tile_id and the capture_id returned by start as expected_capture_id even on the first overview; reuse both for pages and relations. An uncaptured tile reports not_captured; an evicted pinned capture ID is refused so the agent can recapture. No visual-quality or production-performance verdict.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
source "mesh" | "mesh_tile" | "view_depth" Optional Mesh scans, captured geometry tiles, and view-depth observations have distinct provenance and IDs. Default: "mesh".
section "overview" | "actors" | "nodes" | "clusters" | "members" | "splats" | "groups" | "pages" | "semantic" | "relations" | "points" Optional Mesh: actors/nodes/clusters/members/splats. Mesh tile: pages/semantic/relations/nodes/points. View depth: groups/points. Overview returns metadata. Default: "overview".
offset integer Optional Default: 0.
limit integer Optional Default: 32.
cluster_index integer Optional Required for members; optional filter for splats. Indices are local to one scan.
node_index integer Optional Optional authored-node ancestor filter for splats.
member_kind "nodes" | "actors" Optional Default: "nodes".
expected_scan_id string Optional For mesh pages, pass the previous page scan ID to refuse a changed mesh scan.
group_id string Optional For view_depth points only, filter by a fixed world-space cell ID from the groups page. These IDs differ from the World preview’s quantile scopes.
tile_id string Optional For mesh_tile, identify a world-space LOD tile. An uncaptured unpinned tile reports not_captured; an evicted or invalidated expected_capture_id is refused.
page_id integer Optional Required for mesh_tile nodes and points. Get available page IDs with section pages.
expected_capture_id string Optional For mesh_tile, pass the capture ID returned by world_tile_capture even on the first overview, then reuse it for all pages. The exact retained observation is queried; eviction or world changes refuse it. View depth can also use this guard.

world_tile_capture

Start, poll, or cancel an asynchronous World tile capture. Start with either canonical tile_id (tile:LOD:X:Y:Z) or position_cm {x,y,z} plus lod (0–2); position coordinates are centimeters and resolve to the containing tile. Samples bounded CPU mesh geometry from loaded editor actors only; it does not load cells, render, or capture during PIE. Start returns tile_id and capture_id immediately. Poll by capture_id until captured or partial, then read source=mesh_tile with world_semantic_snapshot using tile_id and expected_capture_id from start, including on the first overview and all relation/detail pages.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
action "start" | "status" | "cancel" Required Start a loaded-world tile capture, poll its capture ID, or cancel queued/in-progress work.
tile_id string Optional Canonical World tile address tile:LOD:X:Y:Z, e.g. tile:2:-1:3:0. Tile edges are 4000 cm at LOD 0, 2000 cm at LOD 1, and 1000 cm at LOD 2. Start accepts this or position_cm with lod. Status/cancel may use this or capture_id.
position_cm object Optional World-space point in centimeters for start. Each finite axis must be within ±100,000,000 cm. With lod, the containing tile index is floor(position_cm / (4000 / (1 << lod))) on each axis, including negative positions.
lod integer Optional Required with position_cm for start: 0 = 4000 cm tiles, 1 = 2000 cm, 2 = 1000 cm. Do not combine with tile_id.
capture_id string Optional ID returned by start. Use for status/cancel to follow that exact request. For snapshot pages, pass it as expected_capture_id to pin the captured observation and detect world changes or eviction.

Not callable yet 4

The editor plugin handles these commands, but an agent cannot call them on this version. They are listed so you know the capability exists. Calling one returns an error.

  • level_get_spatial_index NOT IMPLEMENTED — returns status:"deferred" pointing at scene_export, for every call. Documented here so get_tool_signature can explain it, but agent_callable:false so it does not appear as capability an agent can spend a turn discovering is empty. Use scene_export, or wp_get_cells for a spatial summary.
  • ping Diagnostic ping used by sidecar discovery handshake. Not exposed to agents via hayba_invoke — call check_ue_status instead.
  • wizard_chat Hardcoded wizard-style chat for the in-editor panel. Not useful from agents — use hayba_initiate_infrastructure_brainstorm instead.
  • wp_load_cell NOT IMPLEMENTED, and it says so rather than pretending: World Partition cell loading is interactive-only in the editor, so every call returns an error naming that limit. It previously returned ok with loaded:false, which let a caller loop over cells and conclude the world was loaded. agent_callable:false — an honest error is still a command that can never succeed, and the catalogue should not offer it.

No tools match that filter.
